subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should bad Telegram/session-store state be repaired automatically, quarantined through doctor/reset, or only diagnosed in status?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but recovery changes persistent session continuity and operator trust, so automation should not choose deletion, quarantine, or diagnostic-only semantics by itself.

options.title: Doctor/reset quarantine
options.body: Status reports the bad artifact and `doctor --fix` or a first-class reset command backs it up, quarantines it, and recreates clean state.

options.title: Diagnostic-only status
options.body: Status reports size, parse, and schema failures and points to documentation without changing files automatically.

options.title: Startup auto-quarantine
options.body: Gateway startup moves bad state aside automatically and recreates it, accepting stronger self-heal behavior with higher data-continuity risk.

recommendation.title: Doctor/reset quarantine
recommendation.body: Status reports the bad artifact and `doctor --fix` or a first-class reset command backs it up, quarantines it, and recreates clean state.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Telegram status diagnostics and session recovery behavior, and recent history shows repeated work on the Telegram status surface.
